subject: a woman in her sixties in a mustard and maroon checked Chettinad kandangi cotton sari, kneeling barefoot, drawing a white rice-flour pulli kolam with her fingers

setting.place: the open central courtyard (mutram) of a Chettinad mansion in Karaikudi, Sivaganga district: red and ochre Athangudi tiled floor, dark Burma teak pillars, lime-plastered walls, a brass kuthuvilakku lamp unlit on the step
setting.time_of_day: first light on a Margazhi morning in December, before sunrise

lighting: soft cool skylight falling into the open courtyard, faint mist, no direct sun

camera.angle: eye level from the shaded verandah, pillars framing the courtyard

style: documentary photograph, natural colour, fine film grain, quiet and unposed
avoid: Kanchipuram silk or bridal jewellery on a working morning
jasmine garlands, rangoli powder colours or diya rows
North Indian or Rajasthani dress and architecture
Bollywood styling or posed smiles at the camera
